articles.title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
articles.summary: Autoregressive video generation has emerged as a powerful paradigm for World Action Models (WAMs). However, existing approaches suffer from slow training convergence and limited converged accuracy, particularly at high frame rates, as the training supervision is confined to the current chunk without explicit signals about future dynamics; they also suffer from slow inference due to iterative video denoising. In this paper, we present Next Forcing, a multi-chunk prediction (MCP) framework for causal world modeling that enables faster training, higher accuracy, and accelerated inference. Inspire
articles.why: Multi-chunk prediction improves training convergence and causal world modeling for autoregressive video generation.

articles.why: Modality-agnostic inference framework enables low-light video enhancement even when auxiliary sensor streams are missing.

articles.summary: Diffusion-based lip synchronization models achieve strong visual quality and audio-visual alignment, but full-sequence bidirectional attention and many denoising steps make them impractical for real-time inference. articles.why: Autoregressive diffusion distillation enables real-time video-to-video lip synchronization with minimal denoising steps.

articles.summary: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories in large language model (LLM) reasoning cause severe inference bottlenecks due to rapid key-value (KV) cache growth. articles.why: Hierarchical decoding-time KV cache allocation dynamically targets reasoning model bottlenecks across layers and heads.

articles.why: This data center thermal optimization leverages inverse temperature dependence to reduce server power consumption.

articles.why: Zero-copy data movement optimizations in MLIR frameworks eliminate host-accelerator runtime overheads.

articles.title: Itô maps for any-step SDEs
articles.summary: Recent one-step generative models accelerate sampling by learning deterministic flow maps of the underlying dynamics. These methods rely on learning from ordinary differential equations, leaving open how to define an exact distillation procedure for stochastic dynamics. We introduce the Itô map, an any-step stochastic flow map that takes an intermediate state and Brownian path and predicts future states in a single pass. articles.why: It introduces Itô maps to enable exact stochastic distillation for any-step SDE generative models.

articles.why: Proposes a robust distillation method tailored to Flow Matching models to reduce inference overhead.

Transmitting raw, redundant, and noisy pixel data off the sensor remains inefficient, motivating a shift toward focal-plane sensor-processors that perform a significant part of the computation directly within each pixel. We envision pixels synthesizing higher-level signals locally, reducing downstream load, and providing richer inputs for higher-level vision tasks.

articles.title: Video-Mirai: Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models Need Foresight
articles.summary: Causal video generators must predict from the past, but they need not learn only from it. articles.why: Introduces foresight training to mitigate representation-level planning gaps in streaming autoregressive video diffusion models.

articles.why: Proposes hyper-epoch pretraining primitives to explore model populations and overcome single-model multi-epoch saturation.
